title: Example: getting started
description: This is an example quiz to show what the editor can do. Duplicate it to start your own.

questions.title: Sum of two numbers
questions.statement:
Read two whole numbers from the input and print their **sum**.

- The numbers can be negative.
- They can be big: up to 2 000 000 000 each.

> Which type do you need for the result?

**Example**
```
input:  3 4
output: 7
```

questions.title: Is it prime?
questions.statement:
Write a method that returns `true` if `n` is a prime number.

- `n` can be any `int`, also 0, 1 or negative (those are not prime).
- It must be fast, also for very big `n`.

```
public static boolean isPrime(int n)
```

**Examples:** `isPrime(7) == true`, `isPrime(1) == false`, `isPrime(91) == false`
